constraints.name: bending stiffness
constraints.text: transverse tip load of 1 N in opposite-sense bending with a maximum tip deflection of 2 cm (k >= 1 N / 20 mm = 0.05 N/mm), no material failure

constraints.name: buckling
constraints.text: the 1 N opposite-sense tip load must not induce buckling: root moment 1 N x 1000 mm = 1000 N mm; phase B only, perfect boom, stop once past it

constraints.name: coiling on hub
constraints.text: must coil around a hub with a 4 cm radius without material failure
